items.content_html: PromptLog is a AI Chat Navigator, a lightweight Chrome extension that injects a dynamic sidebar into ChatGPT conversations. It indexes only the user's messages (questions) from the chat thread and presents them in a scrollable, clickable sidebar for easy reference and navigation.
